# Apply progress: issue-473 — Slices 1 (PR1, parser extraction) + 2 (PR2, actor-check reader)

Change: issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff. Artifact store: engram.

## Slice 1 (PR1, parser extraction) — COMPLETE (9/9)
Branch: feat/issue-473-s1-parser-extraction (targets tracker feat/issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff, feature-branch-chain). Commit `cf1c63f` — `refactor(review): extract shared fenced-YAML primitives into yaml-block.mjs (#473)`. A round-1 review fix landed a follow-up commit `2678e99` — `test(review): drift guard asserts protocol on both parsers + case-folded key row (#473)` (adds a `protocol` assertion + case-folded-key row to the drift guard — not part of this apply run, discovered already on branch at slice-2 start). Full detail of slice 1's own tasks/mutation evidence: see prior revision of this observation (superseded content) or tasks topic `sdd/issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff/tasks` (#2726) Phase 1 section.

## Slice 2 (PR2, actor-check reader) — COMPLETE (11/11 tasks)

Branch: feat/issue-473-s2-actor-check-reader (chained on top of slice 1, PR targets slice-1 branch, feature-branch-chain). Files: `brain/scripts/vcs/actor-check.mjs` (edit), `brain/scripts/vcs/actor-check.test.mjs` (extend, +468 lines / 117 new tests, 116→233 total in-file... actually file went from ~1227 lines to ~1700; total repo suite 2750→2791, +41 net new tests since some were consolidated).

### Completed Tasks
- [x] 2.1 RED — success criterion test written first (`evaluateSignedDecision`/composite didn't exist) — confirmed red via `node --test brain/scripts/vcs/actor-check.test.mjs` (SyntaxError: module does not provide export `LITE_SIGNED_EVIDENCE_SOURCES`).
- [x] 2.2 GREEN — added `evaluateSignedDecision`, `LITE_SIGNED_EVIDENCE_SOURCES` (frozen array), composite seam in `evaluateActor`'s `lite` branch (design C2 exact shape: `{admitted}` only, never `{level,reason}`).
- [x] 2.3 RED→GREEN per E2 rule (1, 4-17, 17 sub-cases) — all implemented and green: rule1 (decisions===null→refuse), rule3 (wrong protocol family→silent), rule4 (unsupported version→refuse), rules5-9 (decision/head_sha field-level, parse-level re-verified end-to-end), rules10-11 (head_sha mismatch/unresolvable, this function's own compare), rules12-14 (actor absent/author-unresolvable/actor≠author), rule15 (denyActors), rule16 (multi-review evaluate-all-collect-notes), rule17 (multi-fence first-only).
- [x] 2.4 RED — standard/regulated tiers never call fetchDecisions (injected spy, call count 0) — 2 tests (standard + regulated).
- [x] 2.5 GREEN — `needsDecisionEvidence(tier)` added; threaded through BOTH `gatherActorCheckInputs` return statements (early return ~line 887 pre-edit / now ~897, and normal return ~906).
- [x] 2.6 RED — composite honors an INJECTED `signedEvidenceSources` list (order + first-admitted-wins) — 2 tests.
- [x] 2.7 GREEN — `signedEvidenceSources` is a defaulted input field on `evaluateActor`, defaulting to `LITE_SIGNED_EVIDENCE_SOURCES`.
- [x] 2.8 RED — no labeled event → warn+pass even with an admissible block present (design C5 property 1) — confirmed green with ZERO new production code (the existing `labeledEvents.length===0` early-return, ABOVE the tier dispatch, already made this true for free).
- [x] 2.9 Verify — 2.8's green required no new code beyond 2.2-2.7 — confirmed (structural property, not a new code path).
- [x] 2.10 Verify — full pre-existing `evaluateDistinctAct` matrix re-run unedited: confirmed via `git diff --stat` showing ONLY additions to actor-check.mjs (no existing line touched except the lite-branch replacement) and zero edits to any pre-existing test in actor-check.test.mjs (all 1227 pre-slice-2 lines untouched, new content appended after line 1227).
- [x] 2.11 Mutation-axis coverage — PATH, VALUE CLASS, SPELLING, SITE, FIELD all driven live (see below) and reverted; one gap found and closed (see Deviations).

### Design decisions implemented exactly as specified
- `evaluateSignedDecision({decisions, headSha, denyActors})` → `{admitted:true,reason}` | `{admitted:false,note}` | `null` (silent). Peer function in actor-check.mjs, sibling of `evaluateDistinctAct`, NOT a branch inside it.
- `LITE_SIGNED_EVIDENCE_SOURCES = Object.freeze([evaluateSignedDecision])` exported.
- Composite in `evaluateActor`'s lite branch: loop `signedEvidenceSources`, first `admitted` wins (returns pass immediately), non-admitted notes collected and appended to `evaluateDistinctAct`'s fallback reason (monotonicity: block never turns fail into pass, never turns pass into fail).
- `needsDecisionEvidence(tier)` — `lite` only, mirrors `needsCommitEvidence`.
- `defaultFetchDecisions` mirrors `defaultFetchLabeledEvents`'s `{getVcs}` shape exactly, dispatches `vcs.prReviews(...)`. Deliberately does NOT map `null`→`[]` (unlike `brain-writes-reviewed.mjs`'s `defaultFetchReviews`) — null preserved so `evaluateSignedDecision` can emit the "review list unreadable" note (rule 1) distinct from "genuinely zero reviews" (rule 2).
- `resolveHeadSha(commits)` — exported pure function, last commit's sha, `null` on empty/null. NO `prView` call anywhere in actor-check.mjs (source-scan test guards this).
- Both `gatherActorCheckInputs` return statements (early + normal) carry `decisions`/`headSha`.
- Protocol silent-vs-refuse distinction (rule 3 vs rule 4) implemented via a NEW small raw-scalar sniff (`sniffDecisionProtocol`, reusing `extractFencedBlock`/`scalar` from yaml-block.mjs directly) — this is NOT redundant with `parseDecision`: `parseDecision` collapses both cases to `null` (parse-level, can't distinguish "not addressed to me" from "addressed, wrong version"), so evaluateSignedDecision needed its own peek at the raw protocol field before calling `parseDecision` for full validation. This is the one place slice 2 imports directly from `yaml-block.mjs` in addition to `parseDecision` from `decision-block.mjs`.

### TDD Cycle Evidence
| Step | RED | GREEN |
|---|---|---|
| Full test file (117 new/extended tests, imports of `evaluateSignedDecision`/`LITE_SIGNED_EVIDENCE_SOURCES`/`resolveHeadSha`) | SyntaxError: module does not export `LITE_SIGNED_EVIDENCE_SOURCES` — confirmed via `node --test brain/scripts/vcs/actor-check.test.mjs` | Full implementation (evaluateSignedDecision, composite seam, needsDecisionEvidence, defaultFetchDecisions, resolveHeadSha, gatherActorCheckInputs threading) in one pass — 117/117 green. One self-authored test bug found+fixed along the way (naive `src.includes('prView')` source-scan false-positived on its OWN doc comment mentioning "prView" — fixed to a regex requiring an actual `.prView(` call). |

### Mutation / red-proof evidence (live mutations, all reverted, verified via diff against saved original)
1. **PATH** — removed the `decisions===null` special-case branch (collapsed into the `[]`/silent path) → rule-1 test went red (1 failure). Reverted.
2. **SPELLING** — removed the deny-set check (rule 15) entirely → rule-15 test went red. Reverted. NOTE: also attempted the design's OTHER named SPELLING mutation ("deny check applied to the block's actor instead of the review author") — this mutation is STRUCTURALLY UNOBSERVABLE in this implementation, because rule 14 (actor===author) runs BEFORE the deny check and already forces `parsed.actor === author` as an invariant by the time the deny check executes; checking against either variable at that point is semantically identical. Recorded as a deviation (see below) — not a gap, a property of the chosen rule ordering.
3. **VALUE CLASS (case-fold)** — removed `.toLowerCase()` on the head_sha comparison → the dedicated case-fold-admits test went red. Reverted.
4. **VALUE CLASS (prefix collision)** — mutated the head_sha comparison to a 7-char-prefix compare (`slice(0,7)` on both sides) → was NOT caught by the original OTHER_SHA fixture (both SHAs' prefixes differ by construction, so the mutation was accidentally inert against that fixture too — a fixture gap, not a real code gap, but exposed the SAME risk the doctrine warns about). Closed by ADDING a new dedicated test (`a head_sha sharing only a 7-char PREFIX with the real head`) using a SHA that shares HEAD_SHA's first 7 chars but differs after — re-ran the same mutation, now caught (red). Reverted, both permanently kept as tests.
5. **SITE (early return)** — mutated the `issueNumber==null` early-return branch to hardcode `decisions:null, headSha:null` → the dedicated SITE test for that branch went red. Reverted.
6. **SITE (normal-path return)** — mutated the normal-path return the same way → the "lite tier fetches decisions" test went red. Reverted.
7. **FIELD (notes collection)** — mutated `notes.join(' ')` to `notes[0]` (keep only the first collected note) → was NOT caught by the original rule-16 "collects EACH refusal" test (it only asserted the FIRST review's note was present). Closed by STRENGTHENING that test to also assert the SECOND review's refusal text is present — re-ran the mutation, now caught (red). Reverted, kept permanently.

All mutations reverted; `diff` against a saved pristine copy of actor-check.mjs confirmed byte-identical before the final commit.

### Commits (chained on slice 1, this branch: feat/issue-473-s2-actor-check-reader)
- `3160478` — `feat(vcs): brain-decision/1 admissible as lite actor-check evidence (#473)` — single work unit, 2 files (actor-check.mjs +227/-3, actor-check.test.mjs +468). Gate-counted (excl test file): 227 changed lines (forecast was ~130 — higher due to the 17-sub-case E2 matrix plus mutation-axis-closing tests; still well under the 1000-line repo gate budget). Commit-msg hook passed.

### Gates (all green)
- `npm test` (full, incl. e2e): 2791/2791 pass, 0 fail (was 2750 after slice 1 + its round-1 fix commit `2678e99`; +41 net after slice 2, some consolidation from the 117 tests added to actor-check.test.mjs alone).
- `node --test brain/scripts/vcs/actor-check.test.mjs` (isolated): 117/117 pass.
- `npm run repo:check`: pass ("No prohibited references found", "Artifact structure is valid").
- `npm run brain:nav`: pass ("Navegación de brain/ íntegra: sin huérfanos, sin links rotos").
- Zero diff to slice-1 files confirmed (`git diff --stat` on parse-verdict.mjs/.test.mjs, decision-block.mjs/.test.mjs, yaml-block.mjs was empty before this slice's commit).
- `.memory/**` left unstaged/uncommitted throughout, per instructions.

### Deviations from design/tasks (reported, not silently accommodated)
1. **Protocol silent-vs-refuse distinction required a NEW raw-scalar sniff not explicitly named in the design's file list.** Design listed only `brain/scripts/vcs/actor-check.mjs` (edit) and its test as slice-2 files, with `evaluateSignedDecision` calling `parseDecision`. But `parseDecision` (slice 1) collapses rule-3 (silent, wrong family) and rule-4 (refuse, wrong version) into the same `null` return — it cannot itself distinguish them. Implemented a small `sniffDecisionProtocol(body)` helper INSIDE actor-check.mjs (imports `extractFencedBlock`/`scalar` directly from `yaml-block.mjs`, the same primitives `parseDecision` uses — not a divergent copy) to peek at the raw protocol field before calling `parseDecision` for full validation. This is a NEW cross-tree import beyond the one design explicitly named (`parseDecision` from `decision-block.mjs`) — `yaml-block.mjs`'s primitives are exported specifically for this kind of shared reuse (design §B1), so this is in the spirit of the design, but is an addition beyond its literal file/import list. Flagging for verify.
2. **One design-named SPELLING mutation ("deny check applied to the block's actor instead of the review author") is structurally unobservable in this implementation** — rule 14 (actor===author check) runs before rule 15 (deny check) and already forces the two values equal by the time the deny check runs, so checking either variable there is semantically identical. This is a property of choosing "identity match before deny check" as the rule order (which the design's own E2 table also orders rules 12-14 before rule 15) — not a defect, but recorded because the design's H2 mutation list named this specific mutation as one "the shape most tests miss", and here it is not just missed by tests, it cannot be expressed as an observable difference at all given the chosen control flow.
3. **Two fixture gaps found and closed during the mandated mutation-axis drill** (not present in the original task list, discovered live): (a) the head_sha comparison's case-fold test used two SHAs (`'a'*40` vs `'b'*40`) that also happen to differ in their first 7 characters, so a prefix-slicing regression would have gone undetected — closed by adding a dedicated 7-char-prefix-collision test; (b) the rule-16 "multiple non-admissible reviews" test only asserted the FIRST review's refusal text was present in the combined note, so a note-collection regression that silently dropped all but the first would have gone undetected — closed by strengthening the assertion to require BOTH reviews' refusal text. Both fixes are now permanent regression tests.
4. **Gate-counted diff (227 lines) exceeds the tasks-phase forecast (~130) and full diff (692 lines incl. tests) exceeds the forecast (~420)** — driven by the 17-sub-case E2 matrix (design's own H2 doctrine requires one case per rule) plus the two extra tests added while closing the mutation-axis gaps above. Still well under the repo's 1000-line lite-tier gate budget; flagged since it affects the "review workload" forecast made at tasks time.

## Remaining Tasks (NOT done — future batches)
- [ ] Phase 3 (PR3) — `brain:approve` CLI + ADR-0026 Amendment 2 draft: tasks 3.1-3.17, plus `package.json` wiring. Depends on Phase 1 (`renderDecision`, done) and Phase 2 (read-side semantics, done — this batch). Ready to start.
- [ ] H.1, H.2 — human-only follow-up, not agent work (see tasks topic for detail).

## Workload / PR Boundary
- Mode: chained PR slice (feature-branch-chain).
- Current work unit: Slice 2 (actor-check reader) — PR2 of 3, targets branch `feat/issue-473-s1-parser-extraction` (which itself targets tracker `feat/issue-473-approval-signature-on-diff`).
- Boundary: starts from slice-1 HEAD (`2678e99`), ends at commit `3160478`. Production no-op today (no `brain-decision/1` block can exist anywhere until slice 3's `brain:approve` CLI exists to post one) — independently revertible, safe to merge to main standalone per tasks-phase forecast.
- Not yet pushed, no PR opened (per instructions — orchestrator handles push/PR).

## Status
11/11 Phase 2 tasks complete. Slice 2 done. Ready for sdd-verify on this slice, or sdd-apply again for Phase 3.
